title: IVG Pro 12 Peach Ice Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Peach Ice IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pods deliver the soft, juicy sweetness of ripe Peach balanced by a refreshing Menthol chill. The fruit note provides a mellow, rounded flavour, while the cool edge adds brightness and clarity, making this pod a smooth and satisfying all-day option. Each refill pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg Nicotine Salt e-liquid, paired with a separate 10ml refill reservoir. Once connected, the system automatically replenishes the pod as you vape, eliminating refilling or coil changes. Together they can provide up to 12,000 puffs per kit depending on your vaping habits. Mesh coil technology ensures consistent vapour and clear flavour, while the click-fit design makes assembly simple and spill-free. Designed exclusively for use with the IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill reservoir and press until they click into place. Slide the connected pod and refill unit into the device. Wait a few moments to allow the coil to saturate before vaping.
